From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: articolò and artìcoło

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /arˈti.ko.lo/
  • Rhymes: -ikolo
  • Hyphenation: ar‧tì‧co‧lo

Etymology 1

[edit]

Semi-learned borrowing from Latin articulus, derived from artus, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂r̥tús. Compare also the doublet artiglio.

Noun

[edit]

articolo m (plural articoli)

Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
articolo (linguistica)
Wikipedia it
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
articolo (legge)
Wikipedia it
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
articolo (giornalismo)
Wikipedia it
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
articolo (botanica)
Wikipedia it
  1. (grammar) article
    Hyponyms: (definite article) articolo determinativo, (indefinite article) articolo indeterminativo, (partitive article) articolo partitivo
  2. article (in a newspaper, magazine, etc.)
  3. item, article
  4. (usually in the plural) goods
    Synonym: bene
  5. (law) article, paragraph, clause
